adjudication.design_quote: Only RCTs and quasi-RCTs investigating BHT for PSF treatment were included
adjudication.reason: RCT/quasi-RCT-only review with pooled BHT vs non-herbal pairwise meta-analysis; six included studies gives k=6.

trial_inventory.title: Observation on the effect of buyang huanwu decoction and xiaoyao powder in adjuvant treatment of post-stroke fatigue.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: After reviewing the full text of each study, six studies (427 patients with PSF) [ 19 – 24 ] were finally included in the systematic review and meta-analysis ( Table 1 ).

trial_inventory.title: Clinical observation on modified buyang huanwu decoction in the treatment of fatigue after stroke.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: One of the RCTs [ 20 ] that compared add-on BHT variants (conventional therapies including rehabilitation therapies for stroke + BHT variant) with a control treatment (conventional therapies including rehabilitation therapies for stroke only) assessed TCER.

trial_inventory.title: Application of Buyang Huanwu decoction in the treatment of post-stroke fatigue patients in the community.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: One RCT [ 21 ] compared the FSS scores in the BHT variant group with those in the conventional therapy group.
